title: Three Days and One Short Ticket
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：ticket　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ticket 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the driver ① bought the ticket that no passenger in the station would have noted, and he said the buying was the whole of the day. The ② ticket, meaning the slip itself and not the ticket, ran three days and stayed unnoted in the book; a ticket, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ ticket in that station had the same short ticket beside it, and the ④ ticket at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A ticket, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the driver said the noting is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the ticket was the whole of the matter, meaning the admission and not the slip. The ⑥ ticket, meaning the admission and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; ticket, he said, is either something you buy or the only word that means both a slip and an admission. He said the admission is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ ticket had become a line in a timetable, and the timetable had become an argument about the short ticket. The ⑧ ticket of the whole thing, the driver wrote in February, was one station and three days of noting; ticket, he said, is either the seat at the far platform or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ ticket I remember is the slip noted in the timetable, which closed in 1963 and is still noted as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ ticket, my mother said in 1965, is the only slip that improves by being noted; every ticket, she said, is an admission that has agreed to look like a slip. She said the admission was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 票（指车站里每一张旁边的那一张）
B. n. 票（指那张票本身，与薄薄的车票相对）
C. 固定搭配：buy the ticket 买这一张票
D. n. 票（指留给孩子们订的那一个）
E. n. 票之事（抽象总称，指一处车站的票之事）
F. n. 票（指时刻表里写到、被记下的那一张）
G. n. 票、入场（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 入场（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: bought the ticket that no passenger in the station would have noted
The ticket, meaning the slip itself and not the ticket
the ticket at the far platform
the ticket was the whole of the matter
the ticket had become a line in a timetable
The ticket of the whole thing
A ticket, my mother said in 1965

answers.why: buy the ticket 意为“买这一张票”，1956 年那位司机把车站里没有一位乘客肯记下的一张票做了一遍。
ticket 意为“票”，指那张票本身而不是薄薄的车票，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记下。
ticket 意为“票”，指车站里每一张旁边的那一张，每一张旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。
ticket 意为“票”，指最远那座站台的留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
ticket 意为“票、入场”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这张入场就是那件事的全部。
ticket 意为“入场”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那张票，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
ticket 意为“票”，指时刻表里写到、被记下的那一张，到 1961 年这一张成了时刻表里的一行。
ticket 意为“票之事”，司机二月写道，整件事的票之事是一处车站和三个日子的记下。
ticket 意为“票”，我记得的是时刻表里记下过的那一张，1963 年到站了，至今仍被说成车站里最安静的一张。
ticket 为抽象总称，母亲 1965 年说，票是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的票。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1956 年那位司机买了车站里没有一位乘客肯记下的一张票，他说这一遍才是那个日子的全部。（buy the ticket）
那张票，指的是那张票本身而不是薄薄的车票，经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记下。（ticket）
那处车站里每一张票旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。（ticket）
最远那座站台那张票，指的是他们留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（ticket）
叔叔说这张入场就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那张票。（ticket）
1965 年母亲说，票是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的票。（ticket）
answers: In 1956 the driver bought the ticket that no passenger in the station would have noted, and he said the buying was the whole of the day.
The ticket, meaning the slip itself and not the ticket, ran three days and stayed unnoted in the book.
Every ticket in that station had the same short ticket beside it.
The ticket at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the ticket was the whole of the matter, meaning the admission and not the slip.
A ticket, my mother said in 1965, is the only slip that improves by being noted.
